items.title: FCC Approves Controversial Satellite Mirror Project
items.summary: The FCC approved a test launch for Reflect Orbital's mirror satellite, a space-based light-delivery concept that raises regulatory questions about light pollution, glare, and public safety relevant to outdoor lighting standards.

items.title: Trump Administration Declines To Renew USMCA Trade Deal
items.summary: The US will not renew USMCA in its current form, beginning a lengthy review process that could eventually affect sourcing, pricing, and supply chains for lighting manufacturers and specifiers across North America.
